node.name: Find the Purchase Order for the product
Match the product to an item on the Purchase Order
Check off the item and quantity on the Purchase Order
Notify Accounts Payable of the updated Purchase Order
Update inventory for the Products received

mdElement.text: Other staff members fill orders by locating the products required for the order. As they fill the order they update inventory to reflect the fact that they have taken the products. They also notify the Order Processing department that the order has been filled. The clients want the new system to handle the notification to Order Processing.

The receiving clerks receive incoming shipments by matching purchase orders against the stock in the shipment. They inform Accounts Payable department when the purchase order items have been received. The clients want the new system to handle the notification automatically.

The products may come from cancelled orders, returned orders, or vendor shipments. The products are placed in the warehouse in predefined locations. The stock clerk looks up the correct location for the new products, places the products in that location, and updates the location inventory with the product quantity.
The example is taken from "UML Weekend Crash Course" book by Thomas A. Pender

When the orders are filled, they are then packed and prepared for shipping. The shipping folks contact the shippers to arrange delivery. They then update inventory after they ship product. They also notify the Order Processing department when the order has shipped. The clients want the new system to handle the notification to order processing.
